subject: general
question: In which of the following states has the first 'cow cabinet' been established in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Madhya Pradesh becomes the first state to establish the Cow cabinet.
 
• Aim: To promote the conservation of cows in the state.
 
• It includes 6 departments, namely
 
 
• ​__Animal Husbandry
 
• Forest
 
• Panchayat and Rural Development
 
• Home
 
• Farmer Welfare Department
 
• Revenue
 
 
 
• Its first meeting was organized on the day of Gopa Asthami on 22nd November 2020 in Cow Sanctuary in Agarmalwa district in Madhya Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Kamdhenu Cow Sanctuary is India's first cow sanctuary situated in the Agar Malwa district.

 
 
• It was set up in 2017.
 
• It was developed by the MP Gau Samvardhan Board.
 
• It is home to 4000 cows.
 
• It is spread over 472 hectares of land.
